notes_for_editor: Thin record: one register entry and a map page for the mountain summit. The register gives no coordinates ('No coordinates are available'), but the brief's lat/lon 40.94037, -77.24901 sits about 30 m from TopoQuest's summit point (40.940629, -77.249140); the brief's coordinate source is unknown, so it is not changed. TopoQuest describes a summit, not a tower, so the tower's location is unconfirmed. Register does not say 'Buffalo Township' and nothing found supports it. Statewide PA inventory (firelookout.org) would not fetch. Story sits at the low end of the length range because the evidence is thin.
